source.value: Rippers Unmasked — Core Rulebook v1.1 (Soul Weapon)

summary.value: You imbue a weapon with the cleansing energy of your spirit.

system.description: You imbue a weapon with the cleansing energy of your spirit. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon becomes light. If you have that weapon equipped while you cast this spell, you may perform a free attack with it as part of the same action. This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.
